selected_candidate.reason: The locked source tree contains the candidate's entrypoint, configuration precedence, trainer, evaluator, masking behavior and full-score seam at one exact revision. Remaining data, environment, TEST-isolation, numeric-target and v5-parity gaps are explicit and finite, so a candidate-specific proposal can be reviewed without importing evidence from another repository.

not_selected_candidates.reason: The local LightGCN implementation is hash-bound, but its inherited RecBole 1.1.1 configuration, data-loading, trainer and evaluator surfaces are not materialized. This adds a prerequisite source-lock and ABI-closure stage before an equally bounded data/environment proposal.
